title: Email/copy extra invocations use request format — should be response format
description:
The dispatcher (jmap-server lib.rs:190) appends extra invocations verbatim to methodResponses — it does NOT re-execute them. So extra invocations must be response-format objects, not request args.

submission.rs is CORRECT: builds a full Email/set response object as the extra invocation.

Email/copy (email.rs:1141-1155 and 1171-1180) is WRONG: builds request-format objects ({accountId, destroy: [...]} and {accountId, update: {...}}) as extra invocations. A client receiving the batch response sees an 'Email/set' response that contains 'destroy'/'update' keys instead of 'created'/'updated'/'destroyed' — invalid RFC 8620 §3.4 response format.

Fix: Email/copy must build full Email/set response objects for its extra invocations, executing the destroy/update side effects directly (as submission.rs does) and building the response to return.
